profile_text.body:
Pony AI Inc. describes itself as a leading global autonomous driving technology company, founded in 2016 in Silicon Valley. The company says it is developing autonomous driving technology and has accumulated millions of kilometers in autonomous road testing in complex scenarios. Its core technology, which it calls the "virtual driver," is applied across three business units: Robotaxi, Robotruck, and Personally Owned Vehicles (POV). The company states that its autonomous vehicles have traveled over 32 million kilometers (over 13 million miles) on urban roads and highways as of April 2024, and that it holds licenses and credentials to test and operate autonomous vehicles in multiple locations worldwide.

The company positions itself as an industry leader in the commercialization of autonomous driving, with a focus on safe, sustainable, and accessible mobility. Its AI-related offering centers on the virtual driver system, which it says supports everyday travel and commercial logistics across the three business units.

Pony AI Inc. is a public company trading under the ticker PONY, with SEC CIK number 0001969302. Its headquarters is listed as Guangzhou. No litigation involving the company is recorded in the available data.
